unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision deletes the line saying the family's success was due to the field Europe gave them. The next sentence still contrasts the parents' timidity for their children with their boldness 'for themselves', but nothing now shows that the elder Adamses profited from Europe.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The irony against Henry's apparent respectability ('when any one was looking at him') survives intact.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the first draft's captious-critic sentence, about 30 words.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Supports the essential parental-fear irony; this is not listed as optional.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: This loses the opening irony against the father's dislike of Europe, and the comparison now reads as an unsupported generality.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Captious-critic irony cut, leaving 'than for themselves' ungrounded

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision cuts 'Thus far it had remained in the eighteenth century, and the next step took it back to the sixteenth,' so 'He crossed to Antwerp' follows the chiasmus abruptly. It also cuts the closing image of kneeling at the foot of the Cross. 'This was one of the foreseen dangers' then refers only to vague sensual education.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: London is still called eighteenth-century, and Antwerp is still 'mediaeval'. A reader can infer the regression.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the 'Thus far…sixteenth' sentence. Optionally restore 'He was only too happy to feel himself kneeling at the foot of the Cross' with its clause.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Belongs to the essential London/Antwerp section; the cut lines are not in the optional list.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The London-to-Antwerp step backward in time becomes opaque. Parents' fear of Europe's temptations loses its pointed target.
unresolved_should_improve.title: 'Education went backward' loses its century-regression explanation and Antwerp its religious coda

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision cuts 'not very quick' and 'almost religious respect for his guides'. It also cuts the clause that students could learn more from books in a day but must pay fees to get a degree. The verdict 'worthless' now rests only on mumbling.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The Common Law argument and the Pandects remain, so the core logic survives.
